description: Band energy split into the part a ridge fit on held-out azimuthal sectors attributes to the teacher (real) and the part it does not (pseudo), on the TPV feature planes and the voxel logits, for SemanticKITTI, nuScenes and Waymo. Rows b and d are the paired per-frame change from LiSeer-P to LiEqualizer.

protocol.statistic: median over frames; rows b and d pair the two students frame by frame before taking the median
protocol.split: ridge regression on held-out 60-degree azimuthal sectors, so the real part is an out-of-sample fit
protocol.normalisation: divided by the Dense teacher’s own band energy

a.mode: common range, frame top = cap; bars above drawn beyond the axes (capped025_v8cbreak2)

b.mode: tightSplit: zero at the same height h in the row; separate linear scales above / below zero, each side tight to its own data (+6 % margin)

d.mode: tightSplit: zero at the same height h in the row; separate linear scales above / below zero, each side tight to its own data (+6 % margin)

units.x: graph-frequency band index 0-10 (tick label = lower λ edge of the band)
units.y_a_c: band energy divided by the Dense teacher’s band energy (1 = the teacher’s own level)
units.y_b_d: LiEqualizer minus LiSeer-P, divided by the Dense teacher’s band energy
